overview.lead: Hunters are ranged damage dealers with a pet. Blizzard's deep dive says damage is their only role, the pet can tank in solo and small-group play, and Hunters have the longest range of any class.

101.summary: What every Hunter should know before choosing a spec: the Forever changes, the pet, the class quests and the racial choice.

steps.text: Every Hunter trains Aimed Shot at level 20. It shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot, so you fire one or the other.
Arcane Shot shares its cooldown with Summon Hawk, the Beast Mastery talent.
Stand still for about half a second after you move: Auto Shot does not fire before that. Aimed Shot and Sniper Shot no longer stop it.
Lay traps in combat. All traps share one 30-second cooldown, and fire traps scale with your Attack Power.
Scorpid Sting now lowers the target's hit chance by 2%, Disengage drops twice as much threat, and Aspect of the Beast also grants melee Attack Power.

mistakes.mistake: Moving between every shot and wondering why Auto Shot stalls.
mistakes.fix: Since 16 Oct, Auto Shot needs about half a second of standing still before it fires.

mistakes.mistake: Planning a fire trap and a frost trap back to back.
mistakes.fix: Traps no longer have separate fire and frost cooldowns: all of them share one 30-second cooldown.

mistakes.mistake: Buffing your pet with player buffs that raise its stats.
mistakes.fix: Pets can no longer take those buffs. They scale with your gear instead.

steps.text: At level 10, your trainer starts a chain of three Taming the Beast quests for your race.
Finish the chain with Training the Beast. It unlocks Beast Training, Feed Pet and Revive Pet.
Skyborne Hunters do their own versions of the chain on Zephras Isle.
Warcraft Tavern does not list the Human chain yet, so a Human Hunter has no written route for it.

mistakes.mistake: Looking for Feed Pet or Revive Pet at the trainer before the chain is done.
mistakes.fix: Training the Beast, the last quest of the chain, unlocks Beast Training, Feed Pet and Revive Pet.

steps.text: A Dwarf Hunter gets +1% hit with spells and attacks from Artisan's Precision.
A Human Hunter gets +1% crit from Ruthless, cut from 2% on 26 October.
A Skyborne Hunter gets +2% haste from Wind-Blessed.
Leave weapon skill out of the choice: no racial grants it in Forever.
The site holds no reviewed fact on Night Elf racials in Forever yet, so they are not compared here.

mistakes.mistake: Using an older guide that gives Ruthless 2% crit.
mistakes.fix: Ruthless is +1% crit since the 26 October notes.

mistakes.mistake: Choosing a race for a weapon-skill bonus.
mistakes.fix: No racial grants weapon skill in Forever.

steps.text: Your gear makes your pet stronger: pets scale with it, and can no longer take player buffs that raise their stats.
Pets inherit 10% of your Attack Power and 100% of your crit, per Warcraft Tavern. Since 16 Oct they use the higher of your melee or ranged crit.
Keep the pet fed. Happiness scales its damage to 125%, 100% or 75%, so carry Feed Pet supplies.
Each pet family has one unique ability, and Foxes are a new family in Forever.

mistakes.mistake: Letting the pet's happiness drop.
mistakes.fix: Happiness still scales pet damage (125%, 100% or 75%), so feed it before a long session.

Open the build in the talent calculator and check it against your talents in game before you spend points.

overview.lead: Beast Mastery puts your pet at the centre: more pet damage, crit and speed, then Intimidation and Bestial Wrath (50% more pet damage for 18 seconds) deeper in the tree.

points.text: Summon Hawk is new: a hawk dives at your target and keeps attacking for 18 seconds, up to 2 at once, and the ability shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot.
Warcraft Tavern calls Beast Mastery competitive in raids, but says Marksmanship and Survival can out-damage it in some fights and that pet deaths hurt it.

101.summary: Leveling as Beast Mastery, the core rotation and keeping the pet in the fight.

steps.text: Endurance Training raises your pets' Health and Armor by 3% per rank, 15% at 5 of 5, which helps the pet hold mobs.
Spirit Bond regenerates 1% of total health for you and your pet every 10 sec at rank 1 and every 5 sec at rank 2, while the pet is active.
Improved Revive Pet at 2 of 2 cuts Revive Pet's cast by 6 sec and its mana cost by 40%, and the pet returns with 30% more health.
Unleashed Fury raises the damage of your pets and hawks by 3% per rank, 15% at 5 of 5.

mistakes.mistake: Following an older build that spends points on Thick Hide.
mistakes.fix: Thick Hide is gone; Endurance Training now raises your pets' Armor as well as their Health.

steps.text: Stand still for about half a second between moves so Auto Shot keeps firing.
Use Summon Hawk on cooldown. The hawk hits for 32 plus 5% of your Ranged Attack Power and keeps attacking for 18 seconds, and only 2 can be out at once.
Summon Hawk and Arcane Shot share a cooldown: pressing one starts it for both.
Fire Aimed Shot or Multi-Shot when their shared cooldown is ready.
Save Bestial Wrath for burst: your pet deals 50% more damage for 18 sec, on a 2 min cooldown.

mistakes.mistake: Firing Arcane Shot just before Summon Hawk comes off cooldown.
mistakes.fix: They share a cooldown, so that Arcane Shot pushes your next hawk back.

mistakes.mistake: Opening Bestial Wrath on a target that is about to die.
mistakes.fix: It lasts 18 sec on a 2 min cooldown, so open it on a target that will live through it.

chapters.title: Keeping the pet in the fight

steps.text: Intimidation makes your pet stun the target for 3 sec on its next successful attack, and that hit gets 100% more crit chance. It also generates high threat, so use it to win a mob back for the pet.
Intimidation requires Bestial Swiftness, which makes your pets move 30% faster.
Improved Mend Pet gives Mend Pet a 15% chance at rank 1, or 50% at rank 2, to cleanse a Curse, Disease, Magic or Poison effect each time it heals.
Feed the pet before you pull: happiness scales its damage to 125%, 100% or 75%.

mistakes.mistake: Planning Intimidation without Bestial Swiftness.
mistakes.fix: Intimidation requires Bestial Swiftness in Forever.

steps.text: Ferocity raises the crit chance of your pets and hawks by 2% per rank, 10% at 5 of 5.
Frenzy requires Ferocity. At 5 of 5 your pet has a 100% chance to gain 30% attack speed for 8 sec after a critical strike.
Focused Fire adds 1% per rank to all damage you and your pet deal while the pet is active.
Bestial Discipline at 2 of 2 raises pet Focus regeneration by 20% and lets 50% of your mana regeneration continue while casting.

mistakes.mistake: Putting points in Frenzy before Ferocity.
mistakes.fix: Frenzy requires Ferocity.

steps.text: Crit raises your pet's crit too: pets inherit 100% of yours, per Warcraft Tavern, and since 16 Oct they use the higher of your melee or ranged crit.
Pets also inherit 10% of your Attack Power and benefit from Expertise.
Unleashed Fury and Ferocity are weaker than in Classic, but they now buff your hawks as well as your pet.
Treat the hit cap as unknown: Blizzard has published no figure for Forever, and the guides disagree.
Count +1% hit for a Dwarf, +1% crit for a Human and +2% haste for a Skyborne.

mistakes.mistake: Taking an older guide's Classic hit cap as Forever's.
mistakes.fix: Blizzard has published no hit cap for Forever. Plan hit from gear and the Dwarf racial until one is published.

overview.lead: Marksmanship is the pure ranged spec. Its capstone, Sniper Shot, is a long-range shot that also extends the range of your next 3 shots by 10 yards.

points.text: Lone Wolf adds 20% damage with all attacks while you have no active pet, and since 24 Sep skipping it costs nothing, so you choose pet or no pet.
Careful Aim turns part of your Intellect into Attack Power, and Trueshot Aura, now in row 4, raises the Ranged Attack Power of party or raid members within 45 yards.

steps.text: Lethal Attacks adds 1% crit with all attacks per rank, 5% at 5 of 5.
Careful Aim adds 20% of your Intellect to your Attack Power per rank, 100% at 5 of 5.
Improved Arcane Shot cuts Arcane Shot's cooldown by 0.3 sec per rank, 1.5 sec at 5 of 5. It does not shorten abilities that share Arcane Shot's cooldown.

steps.text: Fire Aimed Shot or Multi-Shot on cooldown; they share it.

Weave Aimed Shot and Sniper Shot in freely: since 16 Oct they no longer stop Auto Shot.
When you kill an enemy, or it dies with your Serpent Sting on it, Rapid Killing makes your next Shot within 20 sec deal 10% more damage per rank.

Efficiency at 5 of 5 cuts the mana cost of your Shots, Stings and melee abilities by 15%.
Hawk Eye at 3 of 3 adds 6 yards to your ranged weapons, on top of the longest range of any class.

overview.lead: Survival is rebuilt around melee and traps: Savage Strikes and Predator's Edge boost your melee crits, and Expose Prey and Lacerating Strikes revolve around Mongoose Bite.

points.text: Expose Prey gives your attacks against a target with Hunter's Mark a chance to enable Mongoose Bite, and Lacerating Strikes makes Mongoose Bite add a bleed.

101.summary: Leveling as Survival, the melee rotation, and traps and defense.

steps.text: Survivalist raises your total Health by 2% per rank, 10% at 5 of 5.
Deterrence raises your Dodge and Parry by 25% for 10 sec on a 5 min cooldown. Press it when a pull goes wrong.
Lightning Reflexes raises your Agility by 3% per rank, 15% at 5 of 5.
Savage Strikes adds 2% crit to all your melee abilities per rank, 4% at 2 of 2.

steps.text: Put Hunter's Mark on your target. Expose Prey gives your melee and ranged attacks against it a 5% chance at rank 1, or 10% at rank 2, to enable Mongoose Bite for 10 sec.
Use Mongoose Bite when it is enabled. With Lacerating Strikes it also bleeds the target for 40% of the bite's damage over 21 seconds.
Keep Aspect of the Beast up in melee: it now grants melee Attack Power.
Lay traps in combat; all traps share one 30-second cooldown.
Strider Kick deals 100% weapon damage and gives you 30% movement speed for 3 sec, on an 8 sec cooldown, which helps you stay on a moving target.

steps.text: Entrapment stops every target your trap affects from moving, for 1 sec per rank and 5 sec at 5 of 5.
Clever Traps at 2 of 2 makes Freezing and Frost trap effects last 30% longer and raises Immolation and Explosive trap damage by 30%.
Survival Tactics at 2 of 2 adds 10% to your chance to hit with traps and Feign Death.
Counterattack becomes active after you parry. It deals 50% weapon damage plus 13, immobilizes the target for 5 sec and cannot be blocked, dodged or parried. It requires Deterrence.
Deflection adds 1% Parry per rank, which gives Counterattack more chances to become active.

201.summary: The level-60 builds, stat priorities, consumables, the raid and PvP.

steps.text: Predator's Edge at 5 of 5 adds 30% to your melee ability crit damage and 50% to your off-hand weapon damage.
Resourcefulness at 2 of 2 cuts the mana cost of your traps and melee abilities by 60%, and every melee or ranged ability crit lets 50% of your mana regeneration continue while casting for 30 sec.
Lacerating Strikes, at the bottom of the tree, requires Expose Prey.

mistakes.fix: Lacerating Strikes requires Expose Prey.

steps.text: Surefooted's hit bonus now applies to all attacks: 3% hit at 3 of 3, and movement impairing effects on you last 30% less.
Savage Strikes adds melee crit and Predator's Edge adds melee crit damage, so melee crit feeds two of your talents.
If you dual-wield, Predator's Edge also adds 10% off-hand weapon damage per rank.
Treat the hit cap as unknown: Blizzard has published no figure for Forever, and the guides disagree.
Count +1% hit for a Dwarf, +1% crit for a Human and +2% haste for a Skyborne.

mistakes.mistake: Expecting Surefooted's hit to cover only some of your attacks.
mistakes.fix: Its hit bonus now applies to all attacks.

steps.text: Keep a quiver or ammo pouch stocked: running out means no ranged attacks.
Elixir of Cunning (Alchemy 275) gives +25 Agility and Intellect for 30 minutes.
Grilled Squid now gives +1% crit instead of Agility, and Tender Wolf Steak gives +15 Agility.
Buy healing potions from a First Aid crafter: they are no longer an Alchemy craft.

steps.text: Warcraft Tavern calls Survival competitive in all PvE content.
Rapid Fire also grants +40% melee attack speed, so use it in melee as well.
Trueshot Aura, in Marksmanship row 4, has reached the whole raid since 16 Oct.
Use Tranquilizing Shot to remove Enrage and Frenzy effects.
Carry your own Drakefire Amulet in your bags for Onyxia's Lair, and build fire resistance first.

steps.text: Improved Wing Clip at 3 of 3 gives Wing Clip a 20% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.
Survivalist's Discipline at 2 of 2 cuts the cooldown of your traps and Deterrence by 40%.
Wyvern Sting is gone, so your control comes from traps, Entrapment, Counterattack's root and, if you take it, Scatter Shot from Marksmanship.
Strider Kick's 30% speed for 3 sec helps you stay on a fleeing target.
Against Warriors: Improved Berserker Rage can remove your slows and Spearing Strike dismounts you, so lean on traps, Counterattack's root and Deterrence.

chapters.title: How the Mongoose Bite talents stack

steps.text: Lacerating Strikes bleeds for 40% of the damage Mongoose Bite did, so whatever raises the bite raises the bleed. A Mongoose Bite crit, helped by Savage Strikes and Predator's Edge, leaves a bigger bleed.
Expose Prey sets how often Mongoose Bite is available: a 10% chance per attack at 2 of 2 against a target with Hunter's Mark.

mistakes.mistake: Looking for a button for Lacerating Strikes.
mistakes.fix: There is none: your Mongoose Bite applies the bleed.
